differences.note: Same move in both sources; startup 7, invulnerable frames 1-10, airborne 4-53 and -40 on block all agree, for the base and the Lightning Beast (SA2) version. Capcom's wording is 'Completely invincible to attacks' where SuperCombo says 'Full'; Capcom's own SA3 row says 'Completely invincible' without 'to attacks', so whether Capcom means throws are included on this move is not spelled out. The script most likely failed on Capcom's wording.

characters.notes: Capcom's table has no jump row, so the jump figures cannot be checked against Capcom. Near-misses that do NOT meet the by-frame-3 bar: Surprise Forward Hop (6KKK) has no head hurtbox from frame 4 and no collision box from frame 4 (SuperCombo notes, line 37); Coward Crouch (2PP) is low profile / upper-body projectile invulnerable only from frame 9 (SuperCombo line 34); meterless Vertical Rolling Attacks are airborne from frame 6 and air-invulnerable from frame 8 in both sources. Rolling Cannon (3f startup) needs Lightning Beast plus a preceding rolling special, so it is not a wake-up option. Draft reversals, the four Wild Hunt command grabs and the wake-up Drive Reversal (startup 18, invincible 1-20) match Capcom lines 52-53, 79, 82-83, 70-73 and 93.
